content_sections.heading: ESIC Vacancy 2026 Notification PDF
content_sections.text: Candidates who are interested in applying for the ESIC Recruitment 2026 should first download and carefully read the official notification PDF. The notification contains complete details about vacancy distribution, eligibility criteria, age limit, stipend/salary, selection process, important dates, and application instructions. Reading the official document is important to ensure that you meet all requirements before submitting the application form. Download ESIC Job 2026 Notification PDF

content_sections.heading: ESIC Recruitment 2026 - Vacancy Details
content_sections.text: A total of 37 vacancies are available - 7 for Anesthesia, 1 for Pathology, 1 for Chest, 1 for Dermatology, 2 for ENT, 2 for Medicine, 1 for Obstetrics & Gynecology, 2 for Orthopedics, 4 for Pediatrics, 2 for Radiology, 2 for Surgery, 1 for Psychiatry, 1 for Forensic Medicine, 1 for ICU, 3 for NICU, 1 for Cardiology, 1 for Endocrinology & Metabolism, 1 for Medical Oncology, 1 for Nephrology, 1 for Neurology, and 1 for Urology.

content_sections.heading: ESIC Recruitment 2026 - Eligibility Criteria
content_sections.text: Anesthesia, Pathology, Chest, Dermatology, ENT, Medicine, Obstetrics & Gynecology, Orthopedics, Pediatrics, Radiology, Surgery, Psychiatry, Forensic Medicine, ICU, NICU, Cardiology, Endocrinology & Metabolism, Medical Oncology, Nephrology, Neurology, Urology: PG Degree/DNB or equivalent in concerned specialty from a government recognized University/Institution. For super specialty departments, MCh/DM/DrNB/FNB in concerned specialty from a government recognized University/Institution is required.

content_sections.heading: ESIC Recruitment 2026 - Age Limit
content_sections.text: Maximum Age Limit: 45 years. Age Relaxation to reserved categories will be given as per rules. Candidates should ensure that they fulfill the prescribed age criteria. Calculate your exact age using our Age Calculator before submitting your application to confirm your eligibility.

content_sections.heading: ESIC Recruitment 2026 - Salary
content_sections.text: Rs. 1,48,669/- per month for all posts.

content_sections.heading: Walk-In Procedure
content_sections.text: Candidates who wish to attend the walk-in interview for ESIC Various Posts Recruitment 2026 should follow the steps below. Read the official notification carefully before attending the interview. Candidates must report at the venue as per the reporting time mentioned in the notification. Carry all original documents along with one set of self-attested photocopies such as ID proof, educational certificates, experience certificates (if required), and category certificate (if applicable). Bring the duly filled application form if required in the notification. Verify eligibility criteria before attending the interview. Candidates are advised to reach the venue well in advance to complete registration formalities. Keep extra passport-size photographs for submission if required.

faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to attend the walk-in interview for ESIC Senior Resident posts?
faq.answer: The walk-in interview for the ESIC Senior Resident posts is scheduled to be held on 02 September 2026. Candidates are advised to report at the venue with all necessary documents.

faq.question: Q2. How many vacancies are available for the Senior Resident post at ESIC?
faq.answer: There are a total of 37 vacancies announced for the Senior Resident post at ESIC Medical College and Hospital, Noida, Uttar Pradesh.

faq.question: Q3. What is the educational qualification required for the Senior Resident post?
faq.answer: Candidates must possess a PG Degree/DNB or equivalent in the concerned specialty from a government-recognized University/Institution. For super specialty departments, MCh/DM/DrNB/FNB is required.

faq.question: Q4. What is the age limit for applying to the Senior Resident posts?
faq.answer: The maximum age limit for applying to the Senior Resident posts is 45 years. Age relaxation will be provided to reserved categories as per government rules.

faq.question: Q5. What is the salary offered for the Senior Resident position?
faq.answer: The selected candidates for the Senior Resident post will receive a consolidated salary of Rs. 1,48,669/- per month.

faq.question: Q6. What is the application fee for ESIC Senior Resident recruitment?
faq.answer: The application fee for General and OBC candidates is Rs. 500/-. SC/ST and Women candidates are exempted from paying any application fee.

faq.question: Q7. What is the selection process for the ESIC Senior Resident recruitment?
faq.answer: The selection process for the Senior Resident posts will involve a Walk-in Interview followed by Document Verification.

faq.question: Q8. Where will the walk-in interview be conducted?
faq.answer: The walk-in interview will be conducted at the ESIC Medical College and Hospital, Noida, Uttar Pradesh. Specific details regarding the venue and time will be available in the official notification.

faq.question: Q9. What documents should candidates carry for the walk-in interview?
faq.answer: Candidates must carry all original documents, including ID proof, educational certificates, experience certificates (if any), and category certificates (if applicable), along with one set of self-attested photocopies.

faq.question: Q10. Is this a permanent or contract job?
faq.answer: The ESIC Senior Resident posts are offered on a contract basis.
